tools.name: repair_json
tools.description: Turn broken or messy JSON text into valid JSON. Strips Markdown code fences and prose before/after the JSON, removes comments and trailing commas, converts single/curly quotes, quotes unquoted keys, maps Python None/True/False, inserts missing commas, closes truncated strings/arrays/objects, and wra

tools.name: validate_json
tools.description: Check JSON against a JSON Schema and get every error with its JSON Pointer path. Send the JSON either as text ("input"; broken text is repaired first, and the fixes are listed) or as an already-parsed value ("data"). Optional coerce converts "42" → 42, "true" → true, etc. toward the schema's types b

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: repair_json, validate_json · Public sink: repair_json, validate_json.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: repair_json, validate_json · Public sink: repair_json, validate_json

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
